*{

html,body{
  margin:0;
  background:#F5F3EF
}

body{
  font-family:ui-sans-system, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;

  line-height:1.55
}

input,select,button{
  font:inherit
}

button,select,input{
  outline:none
}

  outline:2px solid #1E4A75;
  outline-offset:2px
}

select option{
  background:#ffffff;
  color:#1F2937
}

  width:10px;
  height:10px
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{
  background:#D8D2C2;
  border-radius:99px
}

@keyframes sheetUp{
  from{
    transform:translateY(28px);
    opacity:.6
  }

  to{
    transform:translateY(0);
    opacity:1
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn{
  from{
    opacity:0
  }

  to{
    opacity:1
  }
}

.sheet-up{
  animation:sheetUp .28s ease-out both
}

.fade-in{
  animation:fadeIn .18s ease-out both
}

    --surface:#F5F3EF

}

<link rel="icon" href="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"><meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Tra Cuu BNC"><meta name="theme-color" content="#122A47"><style id="single-file-mobile-fix">@media (max-width:768px){header{padding:8px 12px !important;}}</style>
<style id="header-ultra-compact">
@media (max-width:768px){
  /* Cụm đầu trang: thụt lên trên, siêu gọn */
  header{padding:5px 10px 4px !important; gap:4px !important;}
  header img[data-fnb-logo]{width:32px !important; height:32px !important; min-width:32px !important; min-height:32px !important; border-radius:8px !important;}
  /* Tiêu đề: dòng 1 to, dòng 2 bắt buộc 1 hàng duy nhất */
  header h1{font-size:12px !important; line-height:1.25 !important; letter-spacing:.1px !important; margin:0 !important;}
  header h1 .title-line1{display:block !important; font-size:13px !important; font-weight:800 !important; line-height:1.25 !important; letter-spacing:.2px !important;}
  header h1 .title-line2{
    display:block !important; white-space:nowrap !important; overflow:hidden !important;
    font-size:10.2px !important; font-weight:700 !important; line-height:1.3 !important; letter-spacing:0px !important;
    /* Vừa khít 1 hàng trong khung điện thoại */
    max-width:calc(100vw - 62px) !important;
  }
  header p{font-size:9px !important; line-height:1.2 !important; letter-spacing:1px !important; margin-top:2px !important;}
  /* Ngôn ngữ: nhỏ hơn nữa, thụt lên */
  header > div:last-child{margin-top:4px !important;}
  .lang-switcher{height:26px !important; min-height:26px !important; max-width:148px !important; padding:2px !important;}
  .lang-switcher button{height:22px !important; min-height:22px !important; min-width:33px !important; font-size:10px !important;}
  /* Tìm kiếm: gọn */
  header + div{padding-top:6px !important; padding-bottom:6px !important;}
  header + div input{height:40px !important; min-height:40px !important; border-radius:11px !important; font-size:14px !important;}
  main{padding-top:8px !important;}
  /* KHI KÉO LÊN: thu gọn mạnh - chỉ giữ logo + tiêu đề + tìm kiếm, ẩn subtitle + ngôn ngữ */
  header.header-scrolled{padding:3px 10px 3px !important;}
  header.header-scrolled p{display:none !important;}
  header.header-scrolled > div:last-child{display:none !important;}
  header.header-scrolled h1 .title-line2{font-size:10px !important;}
  header.header-scrolled img[data-fnb-logo]{width:28px !important; height:28px !important; min-width:28px !important; min-height:28px !important;}
}
</style>

<style id="title-2line-fix">
@media (max-width:768px){
  header h1{font-size:13px !important; line-height:1.35 !important; margin:0 !important; text-wrap:balance !important;}
  header h1 .title-line1{display:block !important; font-size:13px !important; font-weight:800 !important; line-height:1.35 !important; letter-spacing:.2px !important;}
  header h1 .title-line2{display:block !important; white-space:nowrap !important; overflow:visible !important; font-size:10.4px !important; font-weight:700 !important; line-height:1.35 !important; letter-spacing:0px !important;}
}
</style>

<style id="lang-switcher-pro">
@media (max-width:768px){
  /* Header cho phép xuống dòng để ngôn ngữ xuống hàng riêng, căn giữa */
  header > div{flex-wrap:wrap !important;}
  header > div > div{display:flex !important; flex-wrap:wrap !important; width:100% !important;}
  /* Container chứa cụm ngôn ngữ - bắt buộc full width + căn giữa */
  .lang-row{width:100% !important; display:flex !important; justify-content:center !important; align-items:center !important; margin:7px auto 0 auto !important; padding:0 !important;}
  .lang-switcher{
    display:flex !important; align-items:center !important; justify-content:space-between !important;
    width:220px !important; max-width:220px !important; height:32px !important; min-height:32px !important;
    margin:0 auto !important; padding:3px !important; gap:2px !important;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.08) !important; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28) !important; border-radius:999px !important;
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18) !important;
  }
  .lang-switcher button{
    flex:1 1 0 !important; height:26px !important; min-height:26px !important; min-width:0 !important;
    padding:0 !important; font-size:11px !important; font-weight:700 !important; letter-spacing:.3px !important;
    border-radius:999px !important; border:none !important; line-height:1 !important;
    background:transparent !important; color:rgba(255,255,255,.88) !important;
  }
  .lang-switcher button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#C9A227 !important; color:#122A47 !important; box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3) !important; font-weight:800 !important;}
  .lang-switcher button[aria-pressed="false"]{background:transparent !important; color:rgba(255,255,255,.88) !important;}
}
</style>
</head>

<script id="fnb-header-icon-sync">
(function(){function replaceHeaderIcon(){try{var icon=document.querySelector('link[rel="apple-touch-icon"]');if(!icon) return false;var src=icon.href;var header=document.querySelector('header');if(!header) return false;var svg=header.querySelector('svg');if(!svg) return true;if(header.querySelector('img[data-fnb-logo]')) return true;var img=document.createElement('img');img.src=src;img.setAttribute('data-fnb-logo','1');img.alt='F&B BNC';img.style.cssText='width:32px;height:32px;min-width:32px;min-height:32px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;display:block;';svg.replaceWith(img);return true;}catch(e){return false;}}document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){replaceHeaderIcon();setTimeout(replaceHeaderIcon,800);setTimeout(replaceHeaderIcon,2000);});})();
</script>



<script id="remove-sort-ui">
(function(){function removeSort(){try{var selects=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('select'));selects.forEach(function(sel){var label=(sel.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').toLowerCase();if(label.indexOf('sắp')>=0||label==='sort'||label.indexOf('sort')>=0){var c=sel.closest('label');if(c)c.remove();else sel.remove();}});}catch(e){}}document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){removeSort();setTimeout(removeSort,600);setTimeout(removeSort,1500);});})();
</script>



<script id="lang-pro-js">
(function(){
  function fixLang(){
    try{
      var btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button'));
      var langs = btns.filter(function(b){ var txt=(b.textContent||'').trim(); return txt==='VI'||txt==='EN'||txt==='KO'||txt==='HI'; });
      if(langs.length<4) return;
      var pill = langs[0].parentElement;
      if(!pill) return;
      if(!pill.classList.contains('lang-switcher')) pill.classList.add('lang-switcher');
      // Cha của pill = row - bắt buộc full width + căn giữa
      var row = pill.parentElement;
      if(row && !row.classList.contains('lang-row')){
        row.classList.add('lang-row');
        row.style.width='100%';
        row.style.display='flex';
        row.style.justifyContent='center';
        row.style.margin='7px auto 0 auto';
      }
      // Đảm bảo flex cha cho phép xuống dòng
      var flexParent = row ? row.parentElement : null;
      if(flexParent){
        flexParent.style.flexWrap='wrap';
        flexParent.style.width='100%';
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
    fixLang(); setTimeout(fixLang, 500); setTimeout(fixLang, 1200);
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function(){ fixLang(); });
    if(document.body) obs.observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true});
    setTimeout(function(){ try{obs.disconnect();}catch(e){} }, 8000);
  });
})();
</script>
